user_outcome: Agents and humans now receive truthful multivariate capability claims and can inspect exactly which related series entered the guarded candidate, without weakening the evidence required to replace a univariate primary.

candidate_decision.reason: The frozen prospective skill gate failed: zero of six lagged-driver cases admitted VAR because ETS remained the best identical-fold candidate. Gnomon correctly retained its univariate primary, and neither thresholds nor case generation were revised after holdout inspection.

promoted_boundary_fixes: the built-in VAR executable now consumes immutable, validated related_series through ForecastAdapter
multivariate evidence names target, supplied series, retained series, adapter kind/name, and protocol version
Toto 2.0 and TTM no longer advertise multivariate-target support that Gnomon's invoked univariate adapter methods cannot honor
the VAR estimator and admission policy are numerically unchanged within the frozen 1e-9 parity bound
manual_inspection: lagged_driver-4100: VAR completed every fold and beat the mandated baseline margin, but ETS scored better; primary correctly remained ETS
shared_pattern_control-4106: high correlation alone did not admit VAR; the margin check rejected it
independent_control-4109: low correlation made VAR ineligible; supplied related series remained disclosed and retained series was empty
remaining_risks: The retained corpus is synthetic and establishes a conservative no-build decision, not real-world multivariate superiority.
The correlation eligibility calculation is dataset-level while fold forecasts themselves are prefix-only; future work should make eligibility fold-local before using VAR in an automatic default.
Native Toto and TTM multivariate inference remains unimplemented in Gnomon's adapter surface.
No agent-boundary API probe was run because the typed primary/admission relationship did not change; P8 will independently test compact decision briefs.
